description: This file is a shell script used to test the features of the 'git log' command, including formatting options, decoration, graph visualization, signature verification, and various filtering mechanisms. It contains numerous test cases designed to validate the behavior of 'git log' under different configurations and input scenarios.

methods.name: test_cmp_graph
methods.description: Compares the output of a graph visualization of git log with expected output in various formats.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing provided commands and comparing output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail, verifying error messages.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Utility to check for specific patterns in test outputs.
